title: 12 Best Food Halls in Chengdu
description: Explore Chengdu's best food halls! From traditional snack streets like Jinli to modern gourmet hubs in Taikoo Li, discover where to eat the most authentic and diverse Sichuan cuisine. Essential guide for food lovers.

places.name: Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li Food Hub
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any specialty from the basement food court, or a traditional Sichuan hotpot experience at one of the upscale restaurants.

places.name: Jinli Ancient Street Food Area
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order San Pao Tai (Three-Cannon Tea), Ding Ding Tang (Hammered Malt Candy), and any variety of spicy skewers.

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley (Wide & Narrow Alleys) Snack Street
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sweet water noodles (Tian Shui Mian), cold noodles with spicy sauce (Liang Fen), and Mian Yan Wo (noodle nests).

places.name: IFS Gourmet Food Zone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of the popular dessert cafes or opt for a modern take on Sichuan cuisine at a specialty restaurant.

places.name: Chunxi Road Snack Hub
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lai Tangyuan (sweet glutinous rice balls), Zhong Shui Jiao (spicy pork dumplings), and various types of barbecue skewers.

places.name: Chengdu MixC Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the dedicated 'food street' area for smaller, independent stalls, or try a regional Chinese noodle dish.

places.name: Joy City Food Street
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Many people go for the self-service skewers or a bowl of spicy 'maocai' (Chengdu-style hotpot in a bowl).

places.name: New Century Global Center Food Plaza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out the smaller, independent noodle or dumpling shops for authentic local flavors at a good price.

places.name: Wangfujing Department Store Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of the customizable stir-fry bowls or a classic bowl of Dan Dan noodles.

places.name: Dongjiao Memory Food & Bar Street
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sample the craft beers paired with creative Sichuan small plates or find a themed restaurant.

places.name: Zhongshan Road Food Street
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the 'Guo Kui' (crispy flatbreads with various fillings) or a bowl of 'Dou Hua' (silken tofu with savory toppings).

places.name: Raffles City Chengdu Food Hall
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for specialty noodle shops, a range of dim sum options, or popular bubble tea chains.
